profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a public company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA, USA, trading as CRM. Its Slack website describes Slack AI as a productivity tool that can summarize channels and threads, search files, take meeting notes, translate conversations, and automate workflows. The site says Slackbot is a personal AI agent that understands the user and workspace, and that AI features run within Slack's trusted boundary, with customer data not used to train large language models. The site also states Slack is the conversational UI for Agentforce, allowing agents built with Agentforce to run in Slack channels, threads, and direct messages.

The company's AI products include Slack AI, embedded in messaging with message-corpus exposure; Tableau AI (Einstein), a business intelligence tool with natural language queries, CRM data integration, and Trust Layer governance; and Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce, CRM-embedded AI and agents. Salesforce-related MCP servers include ai.cirra/salesforce-mcp for administration, several ai.smithery/kodey-ai-salesforce-mcp variants for SOQL queries, and cloud.serpent/salesforce-devops for deploys and pipelines.

Salesforce's most recent 10-K reports revenue of $41,525,000,000 for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026. The company has CIK 0001108524 and appears in 281 California law exposure records. No litigation cases are listed.
